outcome: Protein expression levels in human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs): vascular adhesion molecule-1 (VCAM-1)
cohort: The study participants were human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs) obtained from the umbilical cords of gestational diabetes mellitus patients and controls who underwent planned cesarean section.
finding: Expression of VCAM-1, PAI-1, and COX-2 was higher in HUVECs from GDM patients compared to controls, and TM expression was also higher in HUVECs from BMI-matched GDM patients.
cross-section timing: Between 2013 and 2014, at the time of planned cesarean section.
